# OpenFlightClaims

> Free, open-source directory of official airline compensation and passenger-rights claim links. No middlemen.

OpenFlightClaims helps passengers find airline-owned claim, refund, and disruption support URLs under EU261 and similar regulations. Community-maintained on GitHub.

## Key pages

- [English](https://openflightclaims.com/en): Primary locale — search airlines and open official claim links
- [French](https://openflightclaims.com/fr)
- [Spanish](https://openflightclaims.com/es)
- [Arabic](https://openflightclaims.com/ar)
- [Urdu](https://openflightclaims.com/ur)

## Contribute

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/OWConnoi/OpenFlightClaims)
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/OWConnoi/OpenFlightClaims/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

## What this is not

Not legal advice. Not a claims filing service. Links should be verified on the airline's official site before use.
